finding.claim: Path normalizer only treats the exact segment '..' as parent traversal. On Windows, segments like '.. ' or '.. .' are resolved by Win32 to '..' after trailing spaces/dots are stripped, so attacker-supplied paths can escape the adapter root.
finding.source: Attacker-controlled location string passed to any Filesystem method (read/write/delete/move/copy/publicUrl etc.), e.g. a download or upload endpoint.
finding.sink: Adapter filesystem operation on the prefixed path (src/PathPrefixer.php:26), adapter not in this repo.

trace.note: switch matches only exact '..'; '.. ' falls to default
default branch keeps the segment as a literal part
implode returns path with '.. ' segments intact
prefixPath concatenates root + ltrim(path); adapter then resolves on Windows and climbs out of root

finding.guards_checked: \p{C} control-char check (line 25) does not cover space or period; allow_relative_path_traversal=false only fires on exact '..' (line 40); ltrim in PathPrefixer only strips leading separators; no whitespace or dot trimming anywhere in src/. Unix/Linux not affected. Confidence medium: normalizer gap verified by reading; exploitability depends on Windows host and OS-path-joining adapter (not in repo), no PoC run.

finding.claim: Reverse visibility mapping fails open: any file mode other than the configured public/private modes is reported as PUBLIC, and cross-filesystem copy/move with retain_visibility (default true) writes that PUBLIC visibility to the destination, widening e.g. 0640/0460 to world-readable.
finding.source: Permission bits of a source file that are not 0644/0600 (set externally, e.g. by umask or another process); attacker must be able to trigger a cross-filesystem copy or move of that file.
finding.sink: Destination writeStream with visibility=public (adapter applies 0644), src/MountManager.php:404.

trace.note: copy() routes to copyAcrossFilesystem when source and destination filesystems differ
visibility read from source via adapter

finding.guards_checked: PortableVisibilityGuard (src/PortableVisibilityGuard.php:9-18) is strict on input only, not on this reverse mapping. Filesystem::resolveConfigForMoveAndCopy (src/Filesystem.php:282-297) only governs same-filesystem retention. Same-filesystem copy is unaffected because the adapter preserves mode. Confidence low: adapter (not in repo) must apply visibility via chmod, and source must have non-standard mode.
